comment: Named experiment registry per slm-learning-102. Every new experiment must claim an EXP-id with hypothesis + dataset + model + cost + eval + pass-threshold. Don't fire training without an EXP-id.

experiments.name: Branch-Train-Merge on GAD domains
experiments.hypothesis: Independent specialists per (project, content_type) cohort, then router-selected, beat a single multi-task adapter on aggregate task quality.
experiments.eval: scripts/eval/mixed_bag_eval.py — 50 mixed cases (12 CLI + 12 doc-V + 13 math + 13 tooluse)
blocking: tool-use v2 retry training on local GPU must finish first
experiments.next_action: Run after tool-use v2 finishes; promotes us to fire EXP-002+

experiments.name: Delta Graph dependency routing
experiments.hypothesis: A learned router (small classifier trained on routing.jsonl) improves task->specialist accuracy over rule-based v1 once routing data crosses ~500 decisions.
experiments.eval: vs current rule-based router; held-out routing decisions
experiments.next_action: Continue running gad team to accumulate routing decisions; check at 500+ entries

experiments.name: SERA-style repo-specialized coder trajectories
experiments.hypothesis: Generating training trajectories from a single repo's memory (commits + tasks + skeletons + failures) produces a SFT corpus that specializes a 7B coder to that repo at lower cost than RL.
experiments.dataset: gad telemetry + git log + .planning/skeletons/ + .planning/handoffs/closed/ — produce ~5k-10k SFT pairs
experiments.eval: repo-memory eval (50 curated tasks where 'repo knowledge' is decisive) + GAD-tools
experiments.pass_threshold: beat bare base by >=15pp on repo-memory eval
experiments.next_action: Author the trajectory generator; ~200 LOC; runs on cpu

experiments.name: Codebase-attention adapter routing
experiments.hypothesis: Codebase-attention scores (per scripts/attention/score.py) when injected as router signal lift task-relevant retrieval recall@5.
blocking: need a curated retrieval golden set (~50 cases)
experiments.next_action: Curate the golden set from existing tasks

experiments.name: Best-of-N patch selection with verifier
experiments.hypothesis: Generating N candidate patches and selecting the one passing the most tests beats single-sample HumanEval+ at fixed model size.
experiments.dataset: HumanEval+ (EvalPlus version) — 164 problems, hidden test cases
experiments.next_action: Pull evalplus dataset; wire test-runner subprocess (10s timeout)

experiments.name: Local tiny router vs frontier router
experiments.hypothesis: A locally-trained 1.5B router classifier matches claude-cli's routing accuracy on owned tasks while running 100x faster and at ~$0.
experiments.model: Qwen2.5-1.5B finetune as classifier OR sklearn baseline
experiments.eval: routing accuracy on held-out + latency p50
experiments.pass_threshold: within 5pp of claude-cli on owned tasks
experiments.next_action: Combined with EXP-002 once data crosses 500+ entries

experiments.name: Soul/constitution prompt impact on outputs (arm C)
experiments.hypothesis: Injecting a Dr. Stein soul system prompt at inference moves measurable model behavior on planning/judgment tasks vs bare-base prompt.
experiments.pass_threshold: >=5pp delta -> train arm B; <2pp -> keep soul as prompt-only; 2-5pp -> widen eval

experiments.name: Skeleton-aware coding agent
experiments.hypothesis: Including 'skeleton' fossil patterns from prior failures + successes in a coder's training corpus improves repo-task pass rate.
experiments.eval: repo-task pass rate on a held-out 30-case set
blocking: skeleton corpus not yet structured for training

experiments.name: Kael voice intent classifier vs rule-based
experiments.hypothesis: A tiny intent classifier trained on accept/reject traces from real Kael interactions beats the rule-based v1 in accuracy + latency.
experiments.pass_threshold: +5pp accuracy AND lower latency than rule-based
blocking: Kael MVP not yet shipping accept/reject traces

experiments.name: Music/soundtrack prompt scorer
experiments.hypothesis: A small reward model trained on artifact accept/reject (when humans approve/reject generated music prompts) predicts human preference better than chance.
experiments.eval: Pearson r vs human ratings on held-out
blocking: artifact corpus collection not yet active
